Text Encoding Initiative

The XML Version of the TEI Guidelines

<entName>

<entName> (entity name) contains the full name of an entity, excluding the percent sign in the case of a parameter entity.
Attributes Global attributes only
Example 
<entName>component.seq</entName>
Module Declared in file teitsd2; Auxiliary DTD for Tag Set documentation
Data Description Must be a valid name.
May contain #PCDATA
May occur within
Declaration 
<!ELEMENT entName %om.RO; (#PCDATA)> 
<!ATTLIST entName  
      %a.global;>
See further 27.3 Entity Documentation
